v2_design_match.detail: Plan implements all v2 requirements: (1) same-pipeline for non-shock days via same universe + vol20d grouping, (2) min_gap=20 to avoid CAR window overlap, (3) complement-of-shock as non-shock definition (data_flow explicitly states 'complement = non-shock'), (4) Spearman+CI via shock_magnitude_correlation, (5) pseudo-DiD with vol-low group as internal control, (6) effect size with 95% CI reported. Three baseline types (random / day-0 matched / market-drop matched) align with the 3+1 condition design from ideas.

minor_notes: Spearman threshold r>0.05 is very low — practically any non-zero correlation passes. However, this is the secondary criterion and the p<0.10 gate is the real filter, so acceptable.
Bootstrap p-value (n_iter=500) in sample_non_shock_baseline is adequate for screening but not for publication. Fine for this stage.

Day-0 matched baseline (2a) matching precision is flagged as a risk in ideas but not addressed in the plan — recommend logging the match quality (e.g., median absolute difference in day-0 return between shock and matched non-shock samples).

No explicit multiple-testing correction across the three baseline comparisons. With only 2 formal comparisons in primary criterion ((3)vs(2a) and (3)vs(2b)), Bonferroni would set threshold at p<0.05 per comparison. Current p<0.10 per comparison is lenient but acceptable given this is exploratory confirmation, not discovery.

pass_criteria.detail: Primary criterion requires pseudo-DiD > 0 AND both matched-baseline comparisons at p<0.10. This is appropriately stringent — requiring both (2a) and (2b) to pass is a form of robustness check. Secondary (Spearman) is correctly marked as supplementary, not required. both_required=false is reasonable.
minor_notes: Consider adding a minimum effect size threshold to primary criterion (e.g., pseudo-DiD > 0.5% over 20 days or Cohen's d > 0.1) to guard against statistically significant but economically meaningless results. Currently only direction (>0) is required.

implementation_feasibility.detail: Existing compute_post_event_car and run_reversal_test functions in run_symmetry_test.py can be directly reused. Data flow is clear. Estimated complexity low-medium is accurate.

recommendations: Log day-0 match quality metrics (median abs difference) for baseline 2a to diagnose poor-match scenarios.
Consider adding a minimum economic effect size to pseudo-DiD criterion (e.g., >0.3% over 20 days) in addition to the directional >0 requirement.
Report the exact bootstrap iteration count and seed for reproducibility.
summary: Plan faithfully implements the multi-perspective v2 design. All six required elements are present. No blocking statistical issues found. Three minor recommendations are advisory only and do not require plan revision before execution.
